title: GPT Image 2.6 vs GPT Image 2.5: Tested (2026)
summary: GPT Image 2.6 vs GPT Image 2.5: six same-prompt tests in Flick, from a call sheet and a Korean menu to a poster and a character across edits, plus prices.
body_markdown:
### Is GPT Image 2.6 better than GPT Image 2.5?


In our six tests GPT Image 2.6 added less text the prompts never asked for, and it adds Planning, SVG output and GIFs. On spelling and on keeping a character the same, both did equally well.


### Is GPT Image 2.6 more expensive than GPT Image 2.5?


Not at default settings in Flick: both cost 5 credits an image. GPT Image 2.6 has a max Prompt Weight that GPT Image 2.5 lacks, which costs 40 credits at 1K.


### Does GPT Image 2.5 have Planning?


No. Planning is new in GPT Image 2.6 and sets how much the model works out a layout before it draws: low, medium or high, at the same price.


### Can both models make a transparent background?


Yes. Both GPT Image 2.6 and GPT Image 2.5 have Transparent Background in Flick, and both returned our camera prop as a clean cutout.


### Can I still use GPT Image 2.5 in Flick?


Yes. GPT Image 2.5 stays in the model list beside GPT Image 2.6, on Flick's Free plan, and a new account gets 100 credits.
